name: someday
description: Things to do or find out about some day: a slow idea list with a "give me something to do" button

scripts.dev: bun run gen && bun run render-config && bun scripts/dev.ts
scripts.build: bun run gen && bun run build:web && bun run build:worker && bun run build:server
scripts.build:worker: bun run render-config && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.build:server: bun run gen && bun build src/platform/bun/server.ts --target bun --outfile dist/server/server.js
scripts.test:bun: bun run gen && bun --bun vitest run -c vitest.bun.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run gen && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cf.json && tsc -p tsconfig.bun.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: bun run gen && biome ci . --error-on-warnings && bun scripts/check-spdx.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: bun run render-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
